item.title: Dappest Branding
item.description:
Dappest is a blockchain startup whose creator I worked with at Guardiome. They brought me onboard to create their branding, business cards, and create other graphical elements for the web app’s interface.

Dappest is best described as “Yelp for DApps” in that it’s a community-driven ranking and commenting platform but focuses on DApps.

Branding

The early stages of branding were very exploratory as the identity of the company was still being formed. The first idea was that of an award necklace in the shape of a “D” for Dappest, but quickly converged on a crown which we thought looked approachable and meaningful.

item.title: Guardiome
item.description: Guardiome is a genomics company that gives people easy access to their genome. I worked with them to design branding, the website and its graphics, product renders, and much more.
